title: Kissed Crisp Indian Potatoes Aloo Gobi
description: A winey, crisp, and adventurous Indian dish featuring sazon and stone-bowl-dolsot, ovo-vegetarian-friendly in the form of aloo-gobi.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the potatoes and cauliflower with olive oil, sazon seasoning, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes and cauliflower in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes and cauliflower are roasting, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chopped onion and minced garlic.
Cook the onion and garlic until they are softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until it is almost completely evaporated, about 2 minutes.
Remove the potatoes and cauliflower from the oven and add them to the skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Make a well in the center of the skillet and pour in the beaten egg, stirring gently to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the egg is cooked through and the potatoes and cauliflower are crispy.
Serve the Kissed Crisp Indian Potatoes Aloo Gobi hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
